investigation_evidence.name: Investigation Evidence Completeness
investigation_evidence.description: Verifies that required investigation actions and forensic artifacts are demonstrated for eligible cases.

escalation_evidence.name: Timely Escalation Evidence
escalation_evidence.description: Evaluates whether high/critical cases received timely escalation within SLA, accounting for valid policy exceptions.

monitoring_coverage.name: Critical Asset Monitoring Coverage
monitoring_coverage.description: Verifies sensor telemetry coverage for critical assets; distinguishes quiet assets from unmonitored assets.

kpi_reconciliation.name: Reported Claim versus Observed Population
kpi_reconciliation.description: Reconciles self-reported entity KPI claims against distinct observed case outcomes within bounded uncertainty intervals.

recurrence_context.name: Asset Incident Recurrence Context
recurrence_context.description: Detects recurring conditions on stable assets while contextualizing benign operational changes and remediation ownership.
